controls.positive: An empty room, no people. Minimal architectural interior painted as an anime film background: graphite walls, ivory paper and diffuse skylight from above. The left half and centre of the frame is a plain smooth graphite wall, almost empty and low in detail. At the right edge one pale desk with a single sheet of blank ivory paper under a soft rectangle of daylight. Almost monochrome graphite and ivory palette, precise and calm, no decoration, no neon. An empty room with nobody in it. Fixed eye-level camera, calm and quiet, hand-painted cel anime film background art. No text, no signs, no logos, no characters, no people, no figures.
